title: What is ChatGPT, really?
description:
What is ChatGPT, really?

ChatGPT is a text helper. It reads your words and gives back a draft, idea, or answer you can edit. If you have not used AI tools yet, this gives you a simple first step without the tech talk.

The full step-by-step guide:
